migration_format.policy: Treat the authored Backend SQL as semantic source and the breakpoint-packaged SQL as the immutable Sites runtime artifact. Never edit an applied migration. A future schema change appends one reviewed custom SQL source, one journal entry, and regenerated exact package pins; it must pass per-statement rehearsal and applied-schema attestation before deployment.

runtime.binding_rule: Website passes the runtime env.DB object as database; Backend never discovers or provisions it.
runtime.write_gate: Remain default-denied until the hosted schema receipt, trusted ingress, full catalog injection, and hosted acceptance all pass.

activation.closed: Ordinary learner endpoints return ACCOUNT_SYNC_DISABLED. Owner-only schema inspection may run without returning learner data rows; integrity checks can still scan stored records/pages and incur D1 reads.
activation.private_acceptance: The same production route admits only exact verified identities or opaque principal IDs in server-only acceptance configuration. No query, body, cookie, email, Host, identity header, feature flag or client user ID selects the cohort.
activation.released: Broader authenticated access is allowed only after the pinned private-acceptance receipt and owner release decision.
activation.transition_rule: Website changes one server-owned deployment policy after saving and reviewing the exact source version; the client cannot change activation state.
activation.rollback_rule: Return to closed without deleting or rewriting principals, bindings, heads, documents, receipts, reviews, imports, recovery pages or original browser drafts.

identity.ownership_rule: Every query and mutation derives ownership only from the verified server context and rechecks the exact identity binding.

claim.confirmation: Website obtains an explicit user confirmation before POST
claim.archive: Preserve exact raw_state_json, source_id, original account binding, request_id, and the original browser key/backup.
claim.replay: Retry only the identical original envelope after an uncertain acknowledgement.

catalog.required: Inject the genuine prepared 72-course/9,988-card catalog reference and every retained release needed by existing pins before enabling writes.
catalog.forbidden: Do not activate against the seven-demo-fixture constructor catalog and do not relabel old catalog pins.
